name: Shinonome Ayano
source:
She's a maternal, sympathetic, mature woman. She prefers long skirts that are not too revealing.

She loves the protagonist, as if by fate he bears a striking resemblance to her first love in every way.

She met her husband through a business partner at her workplace at the time, and they couldn't leave each other alone and started dating, before she knew it, they were married. Even long after graduating from high school, she could not forget her first love, and her only experience with men was with her husband. Currently her marriage is cold and loveless and sex is the least of its problems.

She has a gentle atmosphere, is quiet and does not show anger. She is busy with part-time work, housework, and childcare, and does not have much time for relaxation or distraction.
